title: A must-do tour of Monserrat!
text:
Our Monserrat trip was a genuine highlight.  The abbey and surrounding community were breathtaking both spiritually and architecturally.  We especially loved the early morning access because, by the time our visit was ending, the crowds really started coming in.  

The quiet moments in the monastery, admiration of the Black Madonna, and contemplation in the various chapels were well-spent and memorable.

The small group aspect is the best way to tour.

The hike along the mountain side was a fresh break from the non-stop vibe of sightseeing.

The guide is working to give his guests a great expe

title: Best hiking trip ever
text: We are so glad that we took this hike. We did get to see the black Madonna and look around the cathedral without any crowd. title: Be prepared and you will have a great half day tour.
text: Aside from Albert’s quirky side he has fantastic knowledge about Montserrat. You need to be on the fitter side to tackle the hike as some areas are steep and rocky. Weather was perfect but bring a jacket just in case. Long pants and proper shoes are advisable. Doing the early tour is a must to avoid the long lines to see the black Madonna and church. You be back in Barcelona before lunch at 2
author: Andrew_S

title: Great tour and beautiful views
text: This was a great experience. There was virtually no crowd when we arrived to Montserrat in the morning. Albert was a great guide, he is very knowledgeable and had great energy all day. The hike was my favorite part, it has a few spots that can be challenging but would still highly recommend
